name: Realismo de Textura de Piel
description: Analyzes skin micro-textoure and pore detail for realism
algorithm: Skin Texture Realism — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes skin texture characteristics for video deepfake detection:

1. **Multi - Scale Piel Textura Extracción**: Skin texture is analyzed at multiple scales using Gabor filters and Local Binary Pattern (LBP) descriptors. The texture hierarchy captures: macro-texture (wrinkles, expression lines), meso-texture (pores, fine wrinkles), and micro-texture (skin grain, cell patterns).

2. **Textura Quality Evaluación**: Natural skin texture shows characteristic statistical properties at each scale — specific kurtosis, spatial autocorrelation, and frequency content. The method evaluates texture quality against natural skin models. AI-generated skin often shows: over-smoothed texture (lost high-frequency detail), artificial periodicity, or textures that don't scale correctly with resolution.

3. **Regional Textura Consistencia**: Different facial regions have different texture characteristics (nose more textured than cheeks). These regional differences should be physically motivated and consistent across the face. The method maps texture distribution and checks for anomalies — AI generators may produce inconsistent regional texture, particularly at the boundaries between separately generated regions.

4. **Textura - Expression Interaction**: During expressions, skin texture changes predictably: wrinkles deepen, pores stretch across tension lines, and skin becomes smoother in compressed regions. The method verifies texture-expression correspondence. Deepfakes may show expressions without corresponding texture changes.

5. **Temporal Textura Estabilidad**: Fixed skin texture elements (pores, stable wrinkles, moles) should maintain consistent positions across frames. The method tracks landmark texture features over time — temporal texture instability indicates per-frame independent rendering characteristic of AI generation.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante análisis de realismo de textura de piel. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente para los sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
